S02 | DOI 10.1128/AAC.47.10.3165-3169.2003 | Fig. 1 legend and Results text (Andes et al. 2003)

findings.reason: The supplied item does not explicitly name the test drug or analyte. Candida kefyr identifies the bioassay organism, and cyclophosphamide is the neutropenia-inducing co-medication; neither establishes the assayed test-drug identity.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed confirmation linking this item's PK and binding records to voriconazole and identifying the assayed analyte.

findings.reason: A41 supplies sampling design and assay information, but A42 explicitly states that concentration-time points are in Fig. 1 only and are not digitized. The table contains reported parameters, not concentration-time observations or verified individual trajectories.
findings.needed_material: Authorized source-linked concentration-time values or separately documented figure extraction, preserving group-summary status, sampling times, units, uncertainty and detection-limit metadata.

findings.reason: The ± values in B45:D47 have no explicitly stated statistic. A42 defines geometric mean ± SD for figure concentration-time points, without explicitly extending that definition to the legend parameter estimates. The detection limit is stated, but an LLOQ and record-level censoring flags are not.
findings.needed_material: Definitions of the table estimates and their ± terms, associated sample counts, and any source-reported quantification limits or censoring metadata. Preserve the stated detection limit without relabeling it as an LLOQ.

findings.reason: A43 reports a Results elimination half-life range of 0.72 to 2.9 h while also stating that the legend gives 0.68 h at 10 mg/kg. B47 reports 0.68 ± 0.04 h for that dose. The repeated legend value agrees with B47, but the Results lower bound remains conflicting.
findings.needed_material: Independent review of the source-specific half-life statements and a recorded disposition preserving both the Results range and legend estimate.

findings.reason: MI004 remains OPEN, status CONFLICT, needed_at pk. A43 supports 78% protein binding in mouse serum at 10 and 100 μg/ml. This page does not resolve the supplied conflicting plasma and secondary-table descriptions or their applicability. A single defensible mouse free-exposure conversion cannot be selected from this evidence.
findings.needed_material: Resolve source-specific binding definitions and applicability, retaining unresolved alternatives under SC031 rather than averaging them; carry fu as a sensitivity parameter.

findings.reason: Serum binding percentage and two tested concentrations are available in A43. Binding measurement method, temperature, pH, recovery, nonspecific binding and mass balance are NOT_FOUND. Direct unbound concentrations and applicability of this binding evidence to the reported serum PK estimates are not established.
findings.needed_material: Source-specific binding methodology, reported experimental conditions and quality information, and a justified applicability link to the intended free-exposure inputs.

findings.reason: Three single oral dose levels have reported PK parameters, but their concentration-time records are not supplied. Repeat-dose or treatment-day contrasts are not established. This page cannot establish support for nonlinear mechanisms or time-dependent clearance.
findings.needed_material: Source-linked concentration-time records at the stated dose levels and any relevant repeated-dose histories, treatment days and comparable biological contexts.

findings.reason: MI006 remains OPEN, status DEFERRED, needed_at pk. This item provides reported parameters and a sampling description, but supported mouse and rat model structures and design-permitted predictive checks remain unassessed. No model fitting or numerical adequacy assessment is performed here.
findings.needed_material: Assess the prepared evidence for the conditional choices in SC022 and retain unsupported or unassessable components as limitations.

findings.reason: A41 supplies a study body-weight range and immune/infection context. It does not supply animal-specific weights, parameter-estimate weight associations or complete concentration-basis definitions. The range must not be replaced by an invented representative weight.
findings.needed_material: Review the reported weight range and parameter definitions against the translation approach considered; obtain additional study-specific weight associations only where that approach requires them.

findings.reason: C45:C47 provide reported AUC estimates and units. Their integration window, time origin and total/unbound definition are NOT_FOUND. Matched isolate MICs, response records and endpoint windows are absent from this page.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported AUC window and basis, binding applicability, and explicit regimen-specific links to isolate MICs and response records before fAUC/MIC comparison.

findings.reason: D45:D47 provide reported maximum serum concentration estimates and units. Sampled versus fitted peak definition, peak window and total/unbound basis are NOT_FOUND. These values do not establish individual peak variability or matched exposure-response records.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported peak definition and window, free-exposure applicability, and matched isolate MIC and response records before fCmax/MIC comparison.

findings.reason: MI010 remains OPEN, status DEFERRED, needed_at index. This page supplies no efficacy response records or matched isolate MICs and does not establish record-level PK/PD matching. Candida kefyr is named as the bioassay organism, not as an efficacy isolate or matched susceptibility record.
